# The Pilot Sightings
[italic]Things survey crews saw out past the lanes, and were then told they had not seen.[/italic]
This stack has moved four times. Every time a relay goes quiet, somebody copies it onto a fresh node and the stories come back, a little shorter and a little stranger. Nobody knows who started it. The first entry was signed with a survey crew number that no longer appears in any registry we can reach.
## What Turns Up Here - [bold]Hulls nobody built.[/bold] Curved, ribbed things lying in the rock of dead moons, with no yard marks, no reactor signature and no answer to a hail. - [bold]The pilots.[/bold] Remains found sitting where a crew would sit. Calcified, grey, twice the height of a man or more, depending on who is telling it. Some of the reports say the chest was open. From the inside. - [bold]Charts on stone.[/bold] Points of light painted on cave walls by people who never had telescopes, and the same points on worlds that never met. - [bold]The quiet afterwards.[/bold] Crews reassigned, logs corrected, bonuses paid for signatures.
## House Rules - No names. Crew number, ship class, sector, year. Nothing else. - No coordinates. We learned what happens to people who post coordinates. - None of this is proof. Read it the way you would read a weather report from a world you will never visit.
[color=#D9A44E]LAST RELAY CONTACT: UNKNOWN. IF THIS PAGE LOADED, SOMEONE IS STILL CARRYING IT.[/color]
